english.title: Sell, expose for sale, buy for sale, consign for sale oysters between 14th May and 4th August
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[sold oysters]_
(B)_[exposed oysters for sale]_
(C)_[bought oysters for sale]_
(D)_[consigned oysters to someone for the purpose of sale]_

between 14th May and the following 4th August
english.legislation: Contrary to section 16(1) of the Sea Fisheries (Shellfish) Act 1967.
